name: spectecx
description: Syntax highlighting and diagnostics for SpecTecX (.spectec) specification files.

spectec.languageServer.enable.description: Run spectecx-lsp to report parse and elaboration errors. Turn off to keep syntax highlighting only.

spectec.languageServer.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `spectecx-lsp` binary. Leave empty to look for it at the root of an open workspace folder (where `make lsp` puts it), then on `PATH`. Supports `~` and `${workspaceFolder}`.

spectec.languageServer.arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to spectecx-lsp.

spectec.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and spectecx-lsp in the SpecTecX output channel.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Re-render once typing pauses, after `#spectec.preview.debounce#` milliseconds.
Re-render only when a spec file is saved.
spectec.preview.refresh.description: When to re-render an open IL, SL or PL preview. Rendering elaborates the whole spec, so 'save' is the cheaper choice on a large one.

spectec.preview.debounce.markdownDescription: Milliseconds of quiet before an open preview re-renders. Only used when `#spectec.preview.refresh#` is `live`.

spectec.preview.highlight.description: Colour keywords, prose, names and operators in an open IL, SL or PL preview. Turn off for plain text, exactly as the CLI prints it.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show the file name only, e.g. `;; 1-syntax.spectec:8:1-15:17`.
Show the whole path the elaborator recorded.
spectec.preview.sourceLabels.markdownDescription: How much of the `;; file:line:column` comment heading each definition an IL, SL or PL preview shows. The whole comment is in its tooltip whichever is chosen, and clicking it still jumps to the source.

spectec.ilPreview.refresh.markdownDeprecationMessage: Renamed to `#spectec.preview.refresh#`, which covers the SL and PL previews too. A value set here is still honoured.
spectec.ilPreview.refresh.description: When to re-render the IL preview.

spectec.ilPreview.debounce.markdownDeprecationMessage: Renamed to `#spectec.preview.debounce#`, which covers the SL and PL previews too. A value set here is still honoured.
spectec.ilPreview.debounce.description: Milliseconds of quiet before the IL preview re-renders.
